findings.reason: The sidecar tone for this key is « short verb phrase with its object, sentence case ». The fr catalogue names the close action with the infinitive in every other control (Fermer le navigateur, Fermer l’aperçu, Fermer la console, Fermer le terminal, Fermer les approbations, Fermer le fil, … — 30+ values); the only « Fermeture » in the whole catalogue is ui.console.close.busy, a progress status. In the merged namespace the sibling ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.close is « Fermer {medialabel} », so the imperative is also the merge-consistent choice. The prior FR-EXT-10 proposed_set also put next/previous into « Afficher… » verb phrases; after the union those keys are byte-identical to main’s nominal « Précédent/Suivant » labels, so this re-bind narrows the fix to close only.
